sources.title: WISPedia -- the WISPs Encyclopedia

evidence.text: Organize the landscape of light, feebly coupled particles beyond the Standard Model through concise descriptions of particle content, interactions, motivations and constraints, with pointers to foundational literature and tools.

sources.title: On the Particle Interpretation of the PVLAS Data: Neutral versus Charged Particles

evidence.text: Can optical measurements distinguish neutral scalar/pseudoscalar photon conversion from fermionic or scalar millicharged-particle production as interpretations of the reported PVLAS anomaly, and what parameter regions follow from the available laboratory data?

sources.title: New bounds on millicharged particles from cosmology

evidence.text: Can post-recombination production of sub-eV millicharged particles distort the CMB spectrum enough to constrain models whose electromagnetic charge appears only at small momentum transfer, including proposed explanations of the historical PVLAS anomaly?

sources.title: Astrophysical bounds on millicharged particles in models with a paraphoton

evidence.text: How does a massless paraphoton change astrophysical limits on millicharged fermions, and does entropy transfer during their annihilation justify the previously claimed nucleosynthesis exclusion extending to about 200 MeV?

sources.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Are the assumed light scalar backgrounds stable against the same tower loops used to estimate their kinetic terms? The answer depends on potential protection, including supersymmetric pairing and the size of splittings within the relevant tower.

sources.title: The Lamb shift contribution of very light milli-charged fermions

evidence.text: What hydrogen Lamb-shift bounds apply to very light particles of charge εe when the usual heavy-mass approximation to vacuum polarization fails, and how do fermionic and spin-0 contributions differ?

sources.title: New Constraints (and Motivations) for Abelian Gauge Bosons in the MeV-TeV Mass Range

evidence.text: Low-energy analyses use lepton magnetic-moment integrals, reinterpret a BABAR dimuon signature, estimate beam-dump production times the decay-window probability, and constrain neutron Yukawa forces. Atomic parity violation includes an interpolated finite-range correction K(M_X).

sources.title: First results from the new PVLAS apparatus: A new limit on vacuum magnetic birefringence

evidence.text: Rotate the magnetic field to place birefringence at twice the magnet rotation frequency. A photoelastic modulator adds a known ellipticity; demodulation at its fundamental and second harmonic linearizes and normalizes the small ellipticity signal. Cavity enhancement is N=2F/π.

sources.title: Gauge Coupling Unification with Hidden Photon, and Minicharged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Original and canonical gauge-field bases are related explicitly. One-loop equations explain why running of gY' is independent of gH and χ; two-loop integrations test the residual dependence and variations in vector-like multiplicities and masses.

sources.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Expand about a fixed background, normalize the scalar kinetic term, estimate each state’s propagator correction, and sum states below the probing energy. Solve λ_φ≈1 to estimate strong coupling. The operation retains spectral thresholds but discards numerical factors and detailed loop functions.

sources.title: New probes for axionlike particles at hadron colliders

evidence.text: Optimize cut-based selections and weight detector escape event by event. Estimate dominant Zγ+j and Wγ+j backgrounds with control-channel techniques; the Z method treats dimuon momentum as invisible and applies branching, acceptance and efficiency corrections. Agreement with simulation within 1% is reported.

sources.title: Dark Photon Oscillations in Our Inhomogeneous Universe

evidence.text: The FIRAS analysis fits Iω=Bω(1−〈Pγ→A′〉) to 43 low-frequency monopole data points, using their covariance and a Gaussian likelihood. CMB temperature is profiled as a nuisance parameter; the reported one-sided 95% limit uses TS=−2.71.

sources.title: Gravitational production of dark photon dark matter with mass generated by the Higgs mechanism

evidence.text: How does a Higgs-generated dark-photon mass that decreases after inflation change gravitational production, the longitudinal-mode spectrum, and the parameter space for explaining all dark matter?

sources.title: Variation of $\alpha$ from a Dark Matter Force

evidence.text: Can a very weak, long-range scalar force coupling mainly to dark matter and unstable charged particles be detected through environment-dependent particle masses and threshold-induced variations of α, despite the absence of substantial macroscopic populations of those unstable particles?

sources.title: Global symmetries, hidden sectors and emergent (dark) vector interactions

evidence.text: When can hidden-sector global U(1) currents, coupled to visible currents or charged operators, be represented by emergent dynamical vectors, and how do their masses, locality and observable interactions differ from elementary dark-photon descriptions?

sources.title: Naturally Light Hidden Photons in LARGE Volume String Compactifications

evidence.text: Which hidden-photon masses and kinetic mixings arise naturally in LARGE volume compactifications, and can they reach regions accessible to laboratory, astrophysical or cosmological probes?

sources.title: Constraints on the Photon Mass with Fast Radio Bursts

evidence.text: How strongly can frequency-dependent arrival delays of fast radio bursts constrain a nonzero photon rest mass, and how does accounting for intergalactic plasma dispersion change the inferred upper limit?

sources.title: Light Hidden U(1)s from String Theory

evidence.text: Which masses, gauge couplings and visible-sector kinetic mixings are expected for light hidden U(1)s in LARGE-volume IIB compactifications, including K3 fibrations, and which mechanisms can produce experimentally interesting hidden photons?

sources.title: Chameleon vector bosons

evidence.text: Can a light charged scalar make a vector-mediated U(1) force depend strongly on source size, density and environment, thereby weakening bounds inferred from linear-force analyses? Gauged B−L provides the worked example.

sources.title: Implications of the weak gravity conjecture on charge, kinetic mixing, the photon mass, and more

evidence.text: What phenomenological bounds follow when the WGC is combined with collider and stellar constraints on electric charges, additional U(1) interactions, kinetic mixing, axion couplings, photon mass mechanisms, and proton decay?

sources.title: Experimental targets for dark photon dark matter

evidence.text: Which experimentally accessible dark photon masses and kinetic mixings admit a consistent cosmological relic-production mechanism once the mass-generating sector, backreaction and cosmic strings are included?

sources.title: Bounds on ultralight hidden-photon dark matter from observation of the 21 cm signal at cosmic dawn

evidence.text: How strongly can the cosmic-dawn global 21 cm absorption signal constrain kinetic mixing of ultralight hidden-photon dark matter through the heating it induces in the intergalactic plasma?

sources.title: Dark Energy, the Swampland and the Equivalence Principle

evidence.text: Can early suppression of a scalar-mediated dark-matter force permit appreciable attraction today while retaining acceptable expansion and structure formation? The paper also asks whether the interaction can slow quintessence sufficiently to accommodate a larger exponential-potential slope.

sources.title: The environment dependent dilaton in the laboratory and the solar system

evidence.text: Can a light scalar produce observable laboratory or solar-system forces while its matter coupling becomes small in dense environments? The model combines an exponential potential with a quadratic coupling to prescribed matter density.

sources.title: FRB 121102 Casts New Light on the Photon Mass

evidence.text: What upper limit on the photon rest mass follows from the measured dispersion and securely identified host redshift of repeating FRB 121102, after accounting for foreground plasma, and how could additional FRB redshifts improve sensitivity?

sources.title: Gamma-rays as probes of the Universe

evidence.text: How can gamma-ray propagation constrain the extragalactic background light, Lorentz-invariance violation and photon–axion-like-particle mixing, and what observational and modelling uncertainties limit those inferences?

sources.title: Challenging the Stability of Light Millicharged Dark Matter

evidence.text: Can electrically neutral, very light charged scalar dark matter remain cosmologically stable when its large occupation numbers enhance particle–antiparticle annihilation into gauge bosons? The paper examines direct electromagnetic coupling and coupling through kinetic mixing with a massless hidden photon.

sources.title: Equivalence Principle Violations and Couplings of a Light Dilaton

evidence.text: How do general low-energy couplings of a light scalar translate into composition-dependent free fall, particularly through the quark-mass dependence of nuclear binding, and how should experiments constrain these couplings?

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: The models must reproduce a very small positive energy density and nearly vacuum-like equation of state. Their scalar must remain light on the present Hubble scale, making even small radiative masses and long-range matter couplings consequential.

sources.title: Search for millicharged particles at SLAC

evidence.text: Can a dedicated accelerator search detect light particles with very small fractional electric charge through rare excitation and ionization, or exclude a conditional region of their charge–mass parameter space?

sources.title: Phenomenological implications on a hidden sector from the festina lente bound

evidence.text: What lower mass limits does the Festina Lente bound impose on hidden-sector particles with photon–hidden-photon kinetic mixing, and what follows for milli-charged particles and gauge-protected dark matter?

sources.title: Gamma-Ray Cosmology and Tests of Fundamental Physics

evidence.text: How can cosmological gamma-ray propagation constrain extragalactic background light, cosmic star formation, the cosmological distance scale, intergalactic magnetism, photon-ALP coupling and Lorentz-invariance violation?

sources.title: Scalar gauge fields

evidence.text: What physical fields and interactions result when a real scalar gauge field B accompanies the usual U(1) vector gauge field, particularly after a charged complex scalar develops a vacuum expectation value?

sources.title: Photon mass bound destroyed by vortices

evidence.text: How does the microscopic origin of photon mass affect bounds inferred from galactic vector potentials, and when can Higgs vortices make a massive photon behave effectively Maxwellian on large scales?

sources.title: String (Gravi)photons, “Dark Brane Photons”, Holography and the Hypercharge Portal

evidence.text: How large is hypercharge kinetic mixing for composite dark photons from strongly coupled large-N hidden sectors, including SM-induced mixing, and how do these estimates compare with holographic and perturbative string constructions?

sources.title: On the dynamical generation of the Maxwell term and scale invariance

evidence.text: When does integrating out matter generate a Maxwell term for an initially nondynamical gauge field, and how does this depend on explicit scales, asymptotic freedom, maintained scale invariance or spontaneous breaking of scale invariance?

sources.title: Photon Mass Limits from Fast Radio Bursts

evidence.text: How strongly can frequency-dependent FRB arrival times constrain the photon mass when redshifts are available, given the degeneracy with plasma dispersion and uncertainties in intervening electron densities?

sources.title: Fine Tuning, Sequestering, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can partially sequestered hidden sectors support dark matter or quintessence while remaining weakly coupled to visible matter? The paper offers this as model-building motivation and reports external coupling restrictions without deriving numerical bounds.

sources.title: Rescuing Massive Photons from the Swampland

evidence.text: How can compact abelian factors with ordinary ultraviolet couplings generate a hierarchical light-vector sector?

sources.title: Photon and Graviton Mass Limits

evidence.text: How do theory, laboratory experiments and astronomical observations constrain photon or graviton rest mass, and how do these constraints change when additional fields preserve gauge or general-coordinate invariance?

sources.title: Phenomenological motivation for gravitational positivity bounds: A case study of dark sector physics

evidence.text: Can uncertainty in the allowed negativity of gravitational positivity bounds affect experimentally accessible dark sectors, particularly kinetic mixing, masses and ultraviolet completion of dark photons?

sources.title: Updated bounds on millicharged particles

evidence.text: What laboratory, cosmological and stellar observations constrain the mass and electric charge of millicharged fermions, and how do the bounds depend on a paraphoton or a neutrino interpretation?
